text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains do not erase the damage from a steep decline; I should size positions so one holding cannot dominate portfolio risk.","Selling after a large loss may be prudent, but waiting until a decline is severe can make risk management costly; I should act on forward-looking evidence and predefined limits.","My infrequent reviews make a simple, scheduled check of allocation and investment theses more useful than reacting to short-term account fluctuations."]}
